reason: Adds a new duplicate-key checking mode across core write paths (`INSERT`, `REPLACE`, `LOAD DATA`, admin/table mutations) plus `stmtctx` and low-level table/index code. That can change uniqueness enforcement, conflict handling, and write correctness/consistency semantics in widely used executor/table paths, which is exactly the kind of high-blast-radius runtime behavior that can hide Blocker/High issues.
